definitions.explanation: A small theater where traditional Japanese performing arts — especially rakugo (comic storytelling), manzai (comedy duos), and other variety acts — are performed. Several historic yose still operate in Tokyo and Osaka.

examples.english: To go to a vaudeville theater to listen to rakugo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{浅草|あさくさ}→浅草：28393_asakusa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{寄席|よせ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: There are still variety theaters remaining in Asakusa.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧{寄席|よせ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{落語|らくご}→落語：04457_rakugo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{想像|そうぞう}していた→想像する：06060_souzousuru⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}かった→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
examples.english: I went to a variety theater for the first time, and live rakugo was much more interesting than I had imagined.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
The kanji {寄席|よせ} is a special reading (⟦{熟字訓|じゅくじくん}→熟字訓：24368_jukujikun⟧). The characters literally mean "gathering seat" — a place where people gather for entertainment.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{寄席|よせ} have been a fixture of Japanese urban entertainment since the ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧. Famous {寄席|よせ} still in operation include {新宿末廣亭|しんじゅくすえひろてい}, {浅草演芸|あさくさえんげい}⟦ホール→ホール：11169_hooru⟧, and {鈴本演芸場|すずもとえんげいじょう} in Tokyo. Programs typically feature several performers in succession, with ⟦{落語|らくご}→落語：04457_rakugo⟧ as the main attraction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寄席|よせ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to a variety theater
- {寄席|よせ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to perform at a variety theater
- {寄席|よせ}⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧: variety theater performer
